test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 11 to 16. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '15'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95815ebff13a29164dec09b2b1d7b321ce974183b89287d5f293e1ae49eb0bde.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a558a4594c9d794b303022298c9849dc9e567e0100c3bf54f962e68d61aae662.png] 

We have been given two dices having common number on two faces i.e. 11 and 14.

We can see that, number 15 is opposite to number 16.

Hence, the correct answer is **"16".**
